nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Tech-driven healthcare|Remote medical imaging_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What technique is used to observe internal crack propagation in concrete?
nodes.answer: X-ray Computed Tomography Scanning (X-ray CT scanning) is used to observe internal crack propagation.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Tech-driven healthcare|Remote medical imaging_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How is the contrast in an X-ray radiograph determined?
nodes.answer: The contrast between different regions in an X-ray radiograph or CT image is directly correlated to the X-ray attenuation through that region of the sample.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Tech-driven healthcare|Remote medical imaging_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What capabilities of X-ray computed tomography are described in the work at INL?
nodes.answer: The work describes the post-irradiation examination capabilities of X-ray computed tomography at INL.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Tech-driven healthcare|Remote medical imaging_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is XCT and what information does it provide?
nodes.answer: XCT, or X-ray computed tomography, is a nondestructive technique that provides surface and volumetric information on samples.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Tech-driven healthcare|Remote medical imaging_qna_004
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: When was the computed tomography technique recognized with the Nobel Prize in Medicine?
nodes.answer: The computed tomography technique was recognized with the Nobel Prize in Medicine in 1979.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Tech-driven healthcare|Remote medical imaging_qna_005
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the primary function of XCT as described in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: XCT collects a series of radiographs based on sample rotation and reconstructs them mathematically to produce a three-dimensional (3D) dataset.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Tech-driven healthcare|Remote medical imaging_qna_006
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What software is installed on the Xradia 620 Versa to aid in image reconstruction?
nodes.answer: The ZEISS Scout-and-Scan Control System Reconstructor software is installed for performing preliminary reconstructions from radiographic datasets.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Tech-driven healthcare|Remote medical imaging_qna_007
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the expected growth of CT and MR imaging emissions between 2016 and 2030?
nodes.answer: It is expected that CT and MR imaging emissions will grow by 30% between 2016 and 2030.
